Ten doors

No clear first step

Someone who just found you through a 173k-view reel lands on ten options. With no single next step, most of them save the reel, close the app, and drift.

No masterclass

Nothing shows you who is ready

Coaching and the Practitioner Training rely on people deciding alone. There’s no live moment where the people ready to go deeper show up, stay, and ask for more.

No ads

Every sale rides on today’s post

2,470 posts and 4 of the last 7 days posting. All demand comes from organic reach, so a quiet week on Instagram means a quiet week in the business.

Your content builds trust every day. Right now there’s no single moment that turns that trust into a decision.

My recommendation

A free live class, From Freeze to Flow, between your reels and your offers

You already have the low-ticket products. A free masterclass gives everyone one clear first step, sells your courses and a new Starter Kit to the people not ready for more, and shows you exactly who is ready for coaching or the training.

Fixes the ten doors

Every reel, ad and Substack post points to one place: a free seat. One clear first step, and every seat is an email you keep.

Monetises the 95%

People who aren’t ready for coaching pick up the $37 Starter Kit after signing up, and your evergreen course after the class. A first purchase instead of a scroll past.

Shows you who is ready

The people who show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page are the ones ready for 1:1 work or the training. The application filters before your calendar.

Ads that pay for themselves

Starter Kit and course sales cover the ad spend, so every new coaching or training client comes in on top, without posting more.

The 95%*

Not ready to go deeper yet

They join the free class, buy the $37 Freeze to Flow Starter Kit or your evergreen course, and stay on your email list. You get paid to start the relationship instead of hoping they come back.

The qualified 5%

Ready for 1:1 or the training

They attend live, stay for the practice and apply on the replay page. The pre-call emails warm them up, so calls are with people who already know your method.

Meet Maggie

Hi, I’m Maggie Hayes

I’m a somatic practitioner, coach and author, and the founder of The Core Rising. My work is about trauma healing and identity beyond trauma: awakening all of your inner resources for full-spectrum healing and bold, beautiful living.

I created The Core Rising Method of somatic healing and trauma resolution, and I now train other practitioners in it. I write about this on my Substack, From Freeze to Flow, and my book, Breaking the Survival Cycle, is available to preorder.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. This is an educational class with guided somatic practices. It isn’t therapy or medical care and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

What if I can’t make it live?

Sign up anyway. Everyone registered gets the replay for a limited time.

Do I need any experience?

None at all. Wear something comfortable and find a quiet spot where you can move a little.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, try the practice, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Not lazy”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“That stuck feeling isn’t always what it looks like.”

Body

“From the outside, freeze can look like procrastination or not caring. From the inside, it’s a nervous system doing its best to keep you safe. Pushing harder rarely moves it. Feeling safe enough to move a little often does.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class called From Freeze to Flow. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, soft natural light, the same setup as your chronic freeze reels.

Script 2 · “No rules”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Healing doesn’t have to follow anyone’s rules.”

Body

“There’s no five-step protocol that fits every body. Some days you move with what you feel. Some days you rest. Learning to listen to your own system is the work.”

CTA

“In my free class, From Freeze to Flow, I’ll show you where to start, with a short guided practice. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: outdoors among plants, on-screen text “healing has no rules” in white serif italic.

Script 3 · “Doing the work”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Years of doing the work, and still feeling stuck? Here’s one reason why.”

Body

“A lot of healing happens in the mind: reading, understanding, naming things. Somatic work brings the body along too, through meditation, movement and breath. That’s often where things finally start to shift.”

CTA

“Join me for From Freeze to Flow, a free live class with a guided practice. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to 10 seconds of you moving slowly with the breath.
